place: Uruguay River at Uruguaiana, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
climate_action: Rio Grande do Sul Civil Defense held São Borja above the inundation stage and Itaqui and Uruguaiana at alert. Copernicus EMS reported 289 people displaced in Itaqui and 217 in Uruguaiana.
geometry: Same descending track 010, frame 103, dual-pol HH/HV, 12-day repeat
method: Open-water proxy on the public GIBS false-color mosaic of validated GCOV: mean RGB below 40, and a jump from land brightness (>=75) so speckle is not counted. Browse pixels are about 33 m, not the native 10–20 m gamma0 grid.
